description: Source code for Android OTA update script handling radio and bootloader images, including functions for finding radio images, verifying, and applying updates.

methods.name: FindRadio
methods.description: Finds and returns the radio image file from a zip archive, matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: FullOTA_InstallEnd
methods.description: Performs the final steps of an OTA installation, including writing bootloader and radio images.

methods.name: IncrementalOTA_VerifyEnd
methods.description: Verifies if the radio images in target and source zip files differ.

methods.name: IncrementalOTA_InstallEnd
methods.description: Performs the final steps of an incremental OTA update, including handling radio and bootloader images.
